1. Search the Registry of Open Data for candidate datasets.
2. Confirm the best candidates with dataset details or a STAC search.
3. Write the plan: datasets and why, access, processing steps, limitations.

Plan: build a Central Valley cropland-change layer from NAIP on AWS (slug naip). Access: naip-analytic (4-band MRF) / naip-visualization (RGB COG) in us-west-2; Requester-Pays, so pre-stage a small sample in-region. Steps: 1) select 2020 and 2022 tiles for the Central Valley; 2) compute NDVI from the 4-band imagery; 3) classify cropland vs non-cropland per year with a simple threshold plus a few labelled samples; 4) difference the years and validate against a held-out sample. Limitations: NAIP is leaf-on summer imagery collected every 2-3 years; Requester-Pays transfer costs; classification thresholds vary by crop.

VERDICT: approve
The datasets and access details match the tool results.
